## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List the commands actually run and their results. Identify skipped or unexecuted checks; distinguish local/offline results from live-cloud evidence.

## Scope and evidence

Note any contract, dependency, permission, persistence or simulation-boundary changes. Use synthetic screenshots for interface changes and state any remaining limitations. Never include secrets, databases or browser traces.
